records.english: {HEX:01}That ship... I have never seen it before.{LB}I hope they are not pirates...{PAD}
{HEX:02}Hey, you!{LB}What do you want with this ship? Staring at someone else's ship{LB}and calling us pirates...{LB}How rude!{PAD}
{HEX:02}Yes, mine!{LB}But I will not let you call me{LB}‘you’ like that!{PAD}
{HEX:02}...You are military. I can tell by your uniform.{PAD}
{HEX:02}I hate soldiers. They all hide behind power{LB}and bully everyone!{PAD}
FI!{LB}That is rude to someone you have just met!{PAD}
{HEX:02}If you are trying to pick a fight with me,{LB}you will be disappointed!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:02}What, violence?!{LB}That is what a man with nothing but strength{LB}would think of! Go ahead, try it!{PAD}
{HEX:01}...Do not misunderstand.{LB}I would never strike a woman or child.{PAD}
{HEX:02}Oh...{LB}Are you trying to be a gentleman?{PAD}
{HEX:02}But you will not fool me with that!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:10}You are Lord Hodram Bergstrom, I presume...{PAD}
{HEX:10}I have heard the rumors.{LB}I am Gerhard Ardelknatts.{PAD}
{HEX:10}By the way, Lord Hodram,{LB}why did you tolerate those insults?{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}...There was no point trying to reason with her.{LB}Forgive me, but dealing with people like that{LB}is painful.{LB}{PAD}
Huff... huff... um...{LB}I am sorry about earlier.{PAD}
I had to apologize...{LB}I am truly sorry!{PAD}
Please forgive FI.{LB}I did not mean to pick a fight{LB}with any of you.{LB}{PAD}
I once had a terrible experience with a man{LB}who acted superior simply because he was a soldier.{LB}It made me a little oversensitive.{LB}{PAD}
She is really kind and wonderful!{LB}She just jumps to conclusions and gets carried away...{LB}Really, FI is!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}Your thoughtful apology is appreciated.{LB}I am not offended.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Yes. With someone like you nearby,{LB}her talents can truly be put to use.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}Do not worry about me. And there is not a single{LB}cruel soldier like that in our fleet.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}My one goal is to become one of the world’s{LB}strongest navies.{LB}I will not harm you. You have my word.{PAD}
About me coming here...{LB}FI does not know...{PAD}
{HEX:02}Now that the largest organization in Southeast Asia,{LB}Kuhn Trading, has been destroyed,{LB}we can trade freely here.{PAD}
{HEX:02}With Kuhn Trading under our control,{LB}we can trade freely throughout Southeast Asia.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:02}There is no one like that here.{PAD}
{HEX:02}That is Kamil's real name?{LB}...Kamil has already left.{PAD}
{HEX:02}You know more about it than I do,{LB}don't you?{LB}You are his father, right?{PAD}
{HEX:28}You know about my relationship with Kamil?{PAD}
{HEX:0E}You came back! I am so happy!{PAD}
{HEX:02}And what was that about ‘Father’?{LB}What is going on?!{PAD}
{HEX:02}I owe you an apology.{LB}Kamil is really Kuhn's...{PAD}
Yes... Overijssel is my mother's surname.{LB}My real name is{LB}‘Marinus Kuhn’.{LB}I am the son of that Antony Kuhn.{PAD}
Yes.{LB}Kamil has always been my nickname.{PAD}
My father was a good man once.{LB}When he met my mother,{LB}he was only a very small merchant.{PAD}
They were poor, but every day was happy.{LB}That is what Mother told me.{PAD}
But once Kuhn Trading entered the Spice Islands,{LB}it began making huge profits.{LB}After Father gained wealth, he changed...{PAD}
Greed blinded him.{LB}He thought only of profit{LB}and stopped caring whether his methods were dirty...{PAD}
That was unbearable for Mother and me.{LB}{PAD}
Everyone around us was afraid of Father.{LB}The neighbors even began avoiding Mother and me...{LB}{PAD}
Mother decided we could no longer live here.{LB}She took me back to the Netherlands.{LB}{PAD}
FI...{LB}I never intended to tell anyone about Father.{LB}Especially not you.{LB}{PAD}
That is why I opposed you back then... I am sorry.{PAD}
{HEX:02}I see...{LB}So that is why you objected so strongly...{PAD}
{HEX:02}I did not know, but I doubted Kamil...{LB}I am truly sorry...{LB}{PAD}
...Hey, FI,{LB}will you let me sail on your ship again...?{PAD}
{HEX:02}Of course!{LB}It was hard while you were gone!{LB}You had better work to make up for it!{PAD}
You really have not changed, FI.{LB}You still work people terribly hard.{LB}{PAD}
Ha ha. But that is what makes you FI.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:02}Kamil...{LB}(I am so glad Kamil came back!){LB}{PAD}
You understand now, don't you?{LB}We can make money honestly,{LB}just as we did before.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:28}Hmph. Perhaps you are right,{LB}but I have my own way.{PAD}
{HEX:28}I intend to build everything again from the beginning.{LB}I have not given up on everything.{PAD}
{HEX:28}...Marinus. Keep this for me.{LB}I have no use for it now.{PAD}
{HEX:28}Something I obtained when I was young.{PAD}
Father...{LB}Can you not become the kind father{LB}you used to be?{PAD}
Why? You could start again with Mother,{LB}just as you did before!{PAD}
That is unfair!{LB}You could go see Mother yourself!{PAD}
{HEX:28}Adults have adult matters to deal with.{LB}Goodbye.{PAD}
{HEX:14}Where on earth did he go?!{LB}I cannot predict his actions either...{PAD}
Father... nothing has changed, has it?{PAD}
Oh, forgive me.{LB}I should have introduced myself.{LB}I am Kamil Overijssel.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Kamil... Are you feeling ill?{LB}Your hands are trembling.{PAD}
No, I am fine.{LB}It is just...{PAD}
{HEX:01}Is the girl who was with you well?{LB}Her name was... FI...?{LB}Something like that.{PAD}
{HEX:01}If you are not sick...{LB}then something serious must be wrong.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Why not come aboard my ship for a while?{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}I cannot leave you alone in your state.{LB}Surely you are not planning to quit sailing?{PAD}
No, not at all...{LB}But I would serve aboard a Bergstrom ship?{PAD}
{HEX:01}Kamil,{LB}when you have troubles, go to sea.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Do not shut yourself away when you are troubled.{LB}Keeping busy clears the mind.{LB}Once you are calm, a solution will appear.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}Yes. In those days, the teacher who trained me{LB}in navigation would often take me aboard.{LB}Strangely, my worries always faded away.{LB}{PAD}
...Thank you.{LB}Then I will stay with you for a while.{LB}{PAD}
